subject.title: fix(ci): script-only changes cold-start every Node job

question: Is a monitored post-merge protected-warm consumer log acceptable evidence for the v2 skip path, given that producing that artifact pre-merge would require weakening the protected-cache writer boundary?
rationale: The contributor has supplied after-fix hosted evidence for the retry path and source-level regression coverage, but the exact protected warm-hit state cannot be created by an untrusted PR consumer under the stated cache trust model.

options.title: Accept monitored rollout
options.body: Merge with the existing conservative fallback and require immediate verification that the next protected consumer skips pnpm install using the v2 marker.

options.title: Require alternate pre-merge proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a trusted maintainer-run environment can create and inspect the protected v2 warm-hit path without broadening PR write access.

recommendation.title: Accept monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Merge with the existing conservative fallback and require immediate verification that the next protected consumer skips pnpm install using the v2 marker.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the changed sticky-dependency workflow and the PR is assigned to them.
